subject: Re: Service incident on 2027-02-12 — credit & trial extension request
messages:
From: Jill Harris <jill.harris@acmesoftware.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acmesoftware.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: High latency & partial outage 2027-02-12 — request for credits

Hi Logan,

We saw a significant service disruption this morning starting ~08:20 PST — multiple requests timed out and overall tail latency spiked for roughly 2.5–3 hours. This hit our checkout path and caused a visible drop in conversions. I've attached a short incident report and a latency graph for the window.

Can you share what happened on your side and propose remediation (credits / trial extension / any goodwill gestures)? Our billing team needs an estimate of what to expect for the month so we can reconcile.

Attaching: incident_report_20270212.pdf; latency_graphs_0212.png

Thanks,
Jill Harris
Sr. DevOps Manager — Acme Software
jill.harris@acmesoftware.com
+1 415-555-0132

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jill Harris <jill.harris@acmesoftware.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 10:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: High latency & partial outage 2027-02-12 — request for credits

Hi Jill — thank you for the report and the graphs. I’m really sorry for the impact this caused on Acme’s checkout flow.

Quick summary from our ops triage so far: a mis-scheduled maintenance task caused a subset of GPU pods to restart repeatedly under a specific traffic pattern, which in turn pushed some requests to higher-cost fallback routes. That produced increased queuing and elevated tail latency between ~08:18–11:32 PST.

Monica (CS) and Ben (AM) are CC’d to help with the customer-facing details. Monica — can you coordinate retrieval of any additional logs or customer traces Acme can share? Ben — I’ll work with you on a proposed credit figure and a trial extension if that helps.

For now I can offer an initial goodwill proposal: a 25% credit on February usage for the affected services plus a complimentary one-month trial extension for any paid features they’re evaluating. I’ll run the numbers and follow up with a precise calculation.

I’ll also escalate to finance for final sign-off (stephanie_nguyen).

Regards,
Logan Wright
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com

From: Jill Harris <jill.harris@acmesoftware.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acmesoftware.com, Tom Brits <tom.brits@acmesoftware.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 13:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: High latency & partial outage 2027-02-12 — request for credits

Thanks Logan. The incident report and graphs are attached (same files I mentioned earlier). Our finance contact Tom is CC’d — they need the proposed dollar amount and a short rationale to process any adjustments on their side.

A 25% credit for February would be a good start; in addition we’d like a one-month trial extension applied to their account (Acme Suite) so product can continue testing without immediate pressure. If you can provide the official calculation and a short note we can attach to our billing dispute, that would expedite things.

Appreciate the quick response.

—
Jill

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Feb 2027 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Acme incident — proposed credit calculation and ask for approval

Team — forwarding the thread and attachments from Acme. I ran a preliminary usage reconciliation and attached an example spreadsheet (credit_calculation.xlsx). Key points:

- Affected window: 2027-02-12 08:18–11:32 PST (2h 1m of severe tail impacts + 1h 10m partial degradation).
- Estimated billable token volume in-window: ~3.2M tokens (Acme's reported traffic).
- Proposed remedy: 25% credit on Feb bill for services impacted + one-month trial extension on their paid seat for "Acme Suite" (applied to the account, not refundable cash).
- Ballpark dollar impact: ~$18,400 credit (spread on Feb invoice) — spreadsheet shows line-item calculation and conservative rounding.

Stephanie — can you confirm finance is comfortable with this authorization? If you need an alternate proposal (e.g., token top-up or 15% + 2-week extension) say so and we’ll adjust. Ben — once we have finance approval I’ll send an official offer to Jill with a short acceptance note for billing.

Attaching: credit_calculation.xlsx (calc, internal)

Thanks,
Logan

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 17:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme incident — approval for credits and trial extension

Thanks for the details, Logan. Finance reviewed the spreadsheet and the incident notes (OPS-4821). Given the scale and that this is the first material outage for Acme in 12 months, finance approves the proposed remedy:

- Apply a $18,400 credit to the Feb invoice (25% of impacted services as shown).
- Apply a 1-month trial extension to the Acme Suite subscription (non-transferable).
- No cash refunds; credit will appear as an invoice adjustment.

Ben — please confirm you’ll send the official offer to Jill and Tom with wording for their billing records (include the incident report link and the credit calculation sheet). Also include a short note about our mitigations and the OPS ticket link.

I’ll notify billing to expect the accounting entry (reference: RDW-DEAL-7321).

Stephanie Nguyen
Finance Ops — Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jill Harris <jill.harris@acmesoftware.com>, Tom Brits <tom.brits@acmesoftware.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 17:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Official offer: credit & trial extension following 2027-02-12 incident

Hi Jill / Tom — following our internal review, Redwood will apply the following remedial actions for the 2027-02-12 incident:  

1) An account credit of $18,400 applied to Acme Software's Feb invoice (this will be reflected as an adjustment in your billing portal and on the Feb statement).  
2) A complimentary one-month extension to the Acme Suite subscription (effective immediately).  

Attached: incident_report_20270212.pdf; latency_graphs_0212.png; credit_calculation.xlsx  
Related ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4821  

If that aligns with your expectations, please reply with a short acceptance saying "We accept the credit and trial extension as outlined." Once we receive that, billing will process the adjustment and we’ll mark the case closed.

Thanks for working through this with us — we appreciate Acme's patience and partnership.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
